description:
## Finding

263 instances of `clippy::doc_markdown` warnings — doc comments that mention identifiers (struct names, field names, file basenames, OIDs as numbers) without backticks.

## Examples

```
pkix-lint/src/deviation.rs:1407
    /// evidence_uri flows from Deviation through to DeviatedFinding.
                                ^^^^^^^^^         ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^

pkix-lint/tests/cabf_tls_br_tests.rs:23
//!   int-p256.der                : P-256, CA:TRUE BasicConstraints, 10 years
                                                   ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^

pkix-lint/tests/cabf_tls_br_tests.rs:10
//!   2026-03-15T00:00:00Z = 1_773_532_800
                             ^^^^^^^^^^^^^
```

## Distribution

By crate (counts of `item in documentation is missing backticks`):

- pkix-lint: ~150 (deviation.rs, cabf_tls_br.rs, lib.rs, report.rs)
- pkix-path: ~60
- pkix-revocation: ~20
- pkix-profiles: ~15
- others: ~15

## Fix

`cargo clippy --workspace --all-features --all-targets --fix -- -W clippy::doc_markdown`

Then review the diff to undo any false positives (e.g., a comment that legitimately mentions `BasicConstraints` as a concept rather than a Rust identifier).

## Priority

P4 — bulk doc cleanup. Rendered docs.rs output is fine; this just makes terminal `cargo doc` and IDE hover slightly nicer. Worth doing as a single cleanup commit.
title: P4: 263 doc comments missing backticks around code identifiers (clippy::doc_markdown bulk fix)
